title: Happy Paddler Kayak Tours & EcoVentures

services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Kayak fishing charters are one of the best ways to experience Florida’s inshore marine environment, getting you into the ‘skinny’ waters that larger boats are forced to pass on by. These shallow areas are often along the mangrove fringe or seagrass beds and hold an enormous variety of fish, including the three ‘grand slam’ species: Snook, Red Drum, and Spotted Seatrout. Each fishing charter is customized to suit you and time on the water is typically around 4 hours. We believe that having the right gear can make all the difference in a trip, so we outfit our fishing tours with premium kayaks and equipment: Ocean Kayak Prowler Big Game 2 kayaks decked out with Scotty mounts, Werner paddles,
